description: This file defines the class writeexcel_workbookbig, which extends the functionality of writeexcel_workbook. It includes methods for creating an OLE compound file with multiple worksheets, likely for exporting large Excel files in a format compatible with Excel's binary format. The class interacts with external classes ole_pps_root and ole_pps_file to construct the OLE structured storage and save the resulting file.

classes.name: writeexcel_workbookbig
classes.description: An extension of writeexcel_workbook that provides functionality to store multiple worksheets into an OLE compound document, used for creating large Excel files.

methods.name: writeexcel_workbookbig
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the workbook with the specified filename.

methods.name: _store_OLE_file
methods.description: Creates an OLE structured storage file, appends all worksheet data, and saves the OLE file.
